title: BaseMessage
description: Standard fields on all PhalynX protocol messages (identity, integrity, and ordering), as specified on the Protocol Specification page and the TypeScript interface BaseMessage.
$comment: Derived automatically from a published example or TypeScript-shaped object on https://phalynx.network/docs/protocol. Property types and required fields reflect only the example or interface as shown on the site. additionalProperties is true because the public docs do not claim a closed field set. Placeholder values are illustrative, not live data.

type.description: Event discriminator (MessageType). Published examples use SOS, EVIDENCE_CHUNK, ATTESTATION, and VERDICT. The /ai complete documentation also lists SETTLEMENT.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (shown as a hex-like string in examples)
